findings.title: Reports can't keep up
findings.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 0.67/s (900%): its backlog only grows.

fix.label: Set replicas to 17 and telemetry partitions to 17

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
